shadowWoods.name: Shadow Woods
shadowWoods.title: The Shadow Woods
shadowWoods.teaser: Step into a forest where towering sentinels guard forgotten tales—shadows whisper, golden glades beckon, and the darkness cradles life like a sanctuary.
shadowWoods.description: Colossal trees stand before you, like giant sentinels guarding this ancient forest. Entering the woods is to be mbraced by deep shadows. However, the darkness here brings no fear or insecurity. The melodic whisper of the wind among the trees seems to want to tell stories of times immemorial. The sunlight, which occasionally sneaks between the branches and leaves, creates the golden and friendly clearings. The further you advance towards the heart of the forest, the clearer it becomes that the enormous trunks that surround you, and the intensity of the daarkness, have the sole purpose of sheltering and protecting the lives within them.
shadowWoods.magic: What is it like to be friends with the night? How can darkness harbour feelings other than fear?
shadowWoods.location: You are currently wandering in shadowy woods.

sunkenSavannah.name: Sunken Savannah
sunkenSavannah.title: The Sunken Savannah
sunkenSavannah.teaser: The horizon swallows the earth, then your steps sink into a vast flooded plain—calm waters soothe your weary feet between islands of ancient, towering trees.
sunkenSavannah.description:
The horizon appears to draw close and the sky seems to consume the ground, as if the edge of the world is about to rise up before you.
As you step onto the celestial surface, you realise that you are in a vast flooded plain. With the exception of small islets sheltering immense trees with massive trunks, there seems to be no dry land in sight. However, the water calmly enveloping your legs never exceeds a few feet in depth, and it seems to reinvigorate your tired muscles, making the journey easier.
### Outposts
Due to the scarcity of local resources, there are no settlements within the Sunken Savannahs. However, because they extend over long distances and have waters that are friendly to travellers, it is common to find wanderers and adventurers using the Savannahs as a route for their travels.
Aiming to help such travellers, outposts were built; small establishments on the sparse islets of the Savannahs, opposing the region’s scarcity.
sunkenSavannah.magic:
How do you tame the force of the cascades and learn to be fluid like rivers?
When you enter a Sunken Savannah at night, the darkness will make you lose your way, prohibiting you from leaving the Savannah until dawn.
sunkenSavannah.location: You are currently slogging across a sunken savannah.

mushroomJungle.name: Mushroom Jungle
mushroomJungle.title: The Mushroom Jungle
mushroomJungle.teaser: The air thickens with choking spores among giant mushrooms. Here, even death is gentle, promising rebirth in the cycle of life.
mushroomJungle.description:
A pungent smell settles in. The air begins to thicken around you, then dozens, hundreds, thousands of spores begin to appear as enormous mushrooms take over the environment. It is difficult to breathe. This is an impossible place to navigate for unprepared travellers. It is a place to encounter death, albeit a mild kind of death as, here, all death nourishes new lives.
This Biome is full of harmful spores that spread throughout the iar. If you enter a hex of this Biome without using something to protect yourself, leave immediately or perform a Test of Courage to explore — a Miss will cost you 1 Soul.
### Colossus Mushrooms
Giant mushrooms that have gained a small sense of self now wander aimlessly through the Mushroom Jungles. Some individuals are extremely poisonous, but none display aggressive behavior. The small mushrooms that grow on their caps are very different from the others found in the Jungles, as they are edible and have special properties.
mushroomJungle.magic: How can that which feeds on death strengthen that which is alive?
mushroomJungle.location: You are currently trekking through a mushroom jungle.

prairieSea.name: Prairie Sea
prairieSea.title: The Prairie Sea
prairieSea.teaser: The wind stirs a lullaby of grass and crickets, while an endless golden carpet unfolds beneath the sun—a land of boundless fertility.
prairieSea.description: The wind increases its song and blows more intensely. The serene whispers of the long grass joins the chirping of the crickets in a calm melody. The sun shining upon the immense green-golden fields convinces you, for a moment, that an infinite carpet of gold unfolds beneath your feet. The verdant trees, bent by the wind, and the numerous wild gardens reveal a fertile land.
prairieSea.magic: What answer does the wind blog? What hope does the greenery hold?
prairieSea.location: You are currently traversing a prairie sea.

silentWastes.name: Silent Wastes
silentWastes.title: The Silent Wastes
silentWastes.teaser: Scorching winds warp the horizon, carving red plateaus where cacti stand sentinel in absolute, sun-drenched silence.
silentWastes.description:
The air becomes dry and sharp. The windcarries the warmth of the sun and the horizon distorts from reflected heat. Great plateaus of reddish earth, dotted with small cylindrical cacti, occupy the land before you. Absolute silence sets in.
During the day, due to the high temperatures, you will lose 1 point of any Attribute in each hex of the Silent Wastes you explore. To avoid this damage, leave immediately and return at night or use something to protect you from the heat.
### Oases
Amidst the arid Silent Wastes, you may find small areas that seem like portals to another world. These places are special and can greatly aid you on your journey. There are two types of oases in the Silent Wastes, and you cannot take heat damage while in either of them:
- Palm Paradise: Rising through the turbulent, heat shimmering sky and surrounding a small lake, enormous palm trees cast cool shade across the ground.
- Cactus Sanctuary: Sturdy, cylindrical cacti, green and yellow, take over the deserrt in small islands of undergrowth.
### Heatbugs
Heatbugs are large, cactus-like insects. They have an exoskeleton of rigid thorns and covered in a thick layer of hairs that burn when touched without protection. Heatbugs thorns are highly sought after for makings tools such as heatbugs pliers and water cans.
silentWastes.magic: How can silence support you and noise protect you?
silentWastes.location: You are currently straying into a silent waste.

titanGarden.name: Titan Garden
titanGarden.title: The Titan Garden
titanGarden.teaser: A blizzard of petals fills the air as colossal blooms line the path—a horizon-wide garden of lilies, sunflowers, and roses, watching over every traveler.
titanGarden.description:
An explosion of colours takes over the world. Petals float everywhere, and giant stems line the road. A garden as vast as the horizon itself rises before you. Lilies, sunflowers, roses, daisies, and countless other dazzling flowers touch the sky at they witness, from above, the journeys that cross their domain.
### Garden Whales
These great whales never leave the confines of the Titan Gardens, yet they fly as if weightless. A lush landscape thrives on their backs. Songs tell of pirates from ancient times hiding their most precious treasures upon these cetaceans.
### Leon Flower Gardens
Leon Flowers have a mesmerising scent and a delicious flavour. Their voluminous petals point towards the sky, and they can be found in two colours: red and yellow. They are highly valued ingredients in the preparation of dishes and potions and, on top of that, they are the favourite food of Flowerlions. The only difference between Leon Flowers of different colours is which types of Flowerlions can eat them.
titanGarden.magic: What is the power of fragility? How do you blossom under thr storm?
titanGarden.location: You are currently meandering through a titan garden.

identity.courage_tooltip: These points represent your ability to accomplish what you want. Whenever you need to do something that is not guaranteed to succeed — whether it’s running, jumping, hiding, distracting, escaping, attacking, etc. — you will need to use your Courage points.
identity.health_tooltip: These points represent your life force. Whenever you encounter a hamrful environment or hostile creature, these points are put at risk. If your Soul points ever reach zero, you die.
identity.honor_tooltip:
The wind, rivers, people, creatures, the darkness: everything feels the Honour of everything around it. The greater the Honour, the greater the respect shown.
You can earn Honour by helping those in need, protecting your memories, or filfilling your mission, and this will bring you benefits throughout your journey. However, giving in to violence or causing harm to any ceature will cause you to lose Honour. If your Honour points drop below zero, your freedom to buy items or enter certain places will be limited.
identity.inspiration_tooltip: Inspiration is your connection to the world around you. Whenever you feel like you’ve contributed to this world in a creative way, helped someone, or been happy with something you’ve invented or found, you can give yourself an Inspiration point. Always be kind and reward yourself for taking part in creating this world.
identity.money_tooltip: They allow you to trade, buying or selling items.
identity.stamina_tooltip: These points represent your ability to keep on going. Vigour points define things like how many items you can carry or how long does your Clock takes to tick.

sunkenSavannah.1: The water embracing your legs seems to heal your fatigue and encourage you on your journey. You have +1 Courage bonus (max 5) until you cross the line between day and night on your Clock.
sunkenSavannah.2: A **traveller** crosses your path. Turn to page 56 to define who you meet. The traveller will not be here when you return.
sunkenSavannah.5:
You come across a **Hedgebog**. Learn more about them on page 22. Draw a card to find out what type of Hedgebog you have encoutered.
- ♥♦ A docile Hedgebog.
- ♠♣ An aggressive Hedgebog.
sunkenSavannah.6: You meet a **Saddle-Duck**. What does it look like? You can ride them if you feed them or succeed in a Test of Courage. They can  take you to any previously explored hex without moving your Clock, returning to their original hex immediately after.
sunkenSavannah.3|4: You find an **outpost**. Learn more on page 23.

mushroomJungle.1: A **spore storm** envelops you. No protection si enough in this situation. Lose 1 point of any Attribute.
mushroomJungle.2: A **ruin** appears amidst the mass of fungus that spreads out on all sides. Turn to page 63 if you want to enter.
mushroomJungle.5:
You come across a **Colossus Mushroom**. Draw a card to find out which type you have found. Learn more about them on page 26.
- ♦ A Stationary Colossus Mushroom.
- ♥ A Wanderer Colossus Mushroom.
- ♣ A Poisonous Stationary Colossus Mushroom.
- ♠ An Poisonous Wanderer Colossus Mushroom.
mushroomJungle.6: You discover a **Dead Garden**: a Colossus Mushroom that has perished or forgotten to awake, giving life of thousands of other fungi. Go to page 26 and choose 1 item from the Gathering Table, no equipment required.
mushroomJungle.3|4: You find a group of 1d6 **Mylians**. Learn more about them on page 27.

prairieSea.1: Strong winds blow against your path. Have a meal or roll a successful Test of Courage to stand firm against the gale. Otherwise, choose between losing & item or 1 Vigour point. If you return to this hex, the wind will still be blowing.
prairieSea.2: A **traveller** crosses your path. Turn to page 57 to define who you met. The traveller will not be here when you return.
prairieSea.3: You find a small **Community Garden**! Go to the Gathering Table on page 30 and choose any item without the need for equipment. Mark this garden as used. You must have a watering can to tend to the garden in order to reuse it.
prairieSea.6:
You find a **creature**. Draw a card from the deck to find out which creature you have found.
- ♦ A Red Flowerlion — turn to page 30.
- ♥ A Yellow Flowerlion — turn to page 30.
- ♣ A White Flowerlion — turn to page 30.
- ♠ A Peezee. Learn more on page 62.
prairieSea.4|5: You arrive at a **Cucurbit farm**.Learn more about Cucurbits on page 30. When you find a Cucubirt farm, turn to page 42 and draw 5 cards to [define this town](/en/generators/village?f=cucurbits).

shadowWoods.1: Dense shadows embrace you tightly. Because of the darkness, everything you encounter in this area of Shadow Woods will be erased from your journal and map. When you pass through these hexes again, roll for new encounters.
shadowWoods.4: You encounter **Fireflies**. Once per day, if you pass through this location, you can recover 1 point of any Attribute.
shadowWoods.2|3:
You arrive at a **[Bruja village](/en/generators/village?f=bruja).**
Learn more about Brujas on page 18. When you find a Bruka village, turn to page 42 and draw 5 cards to define it.
shadowWoods.5|6:
You encounter a **creature**. Draw a card from the deck to find out what it is:
- ♦ A flock of **Yabas** — turn to page 19.
- ♥ A lone Yaba — turn to page 19.
- ♣ A Warrior Tree, which starts a battle. Learn more on page 19.
- ♠ A **Peezee**. Learn more on page 62.

silentWastes.1: Deep sand makes the path even more tiring. Have a meal or roll a successful Test of Courage to overcome this challenge. Otherwise, choose between losing 1 item or 1 Vigour point. If you return to this hex, the sand will have the same effect.
silentWastes.2: A **ruin** appears among the sandy rocks. Turn to page 63 if you want to enter.
silentWastes.3:
You discover an **oasis**. Learn more on page 36. Draw a card to find out what type of Oasis you have found.
- ♥♦ A Palm Paradise.
- ♠♣ A Cactus Sanctuary.
silentWastes.4: You meet a **Kiore**. Learn more about them on page 34. Go to page 57 if you want to define  the Kiore’s personality. The Kiore will not be here when you return.
silentWastes.5|6:
You come across a **Heatbug**. Learn more about them on page 37. Draw a card to find out what type of Heatbug you have encountered.
- ♦ A Docile Heatbug.
- ♥ An Hostile Heatbug.
- ♠♣ A Fallen Heatbug.

titanGarden.1: You stumble upon a pasture of **Titan Bees**. They start a battle, and you must make a Test of Courage to fight or flee. The next time you pass through this hex, the Titan Bees will still be here, guarding their pasture.
titanGarden.4:
You discover a garden of **Golden Petals**. Draw a card from the deck to find out what type of Golden Petals you have found.
- ♥♦ Bloomed: can be picked up as 100 coins but they stop growing.
- ♠♣ Buds: can be consumed as 1d6 meals, but they stop growing.
titanGarden.5:
You find a **Garden Whale**. Learn more on page 40. Draw a card to find out what type of Garden Whale you have found.
- ♥♦ A Docile Garden Whale.
- ♠♣ A Hostile Garden Whale.
titanGarden.6: You discover a colossal **Garden Whale skeleton**. Turn to page 40 and roll for the treasure you find here.
titanGarden.2|3:
You find a normal-sized **Leon Flower Garden**. Learn more on page 41. Draw a card to determine what type of Leon Flower you have found.
- ♥♦ Red Leon Flowers.
- ♠♣ Yellow Leon Flowers.

shadowWoods.hint:
To collect resources in any hex of the Shadow Woods, you need to:
- Use an Axe, spending 1 of its durability points, and choose anything you wish from the Gathering Table.
- Or roll a Test of Courage and, on a Hit, roll what you find on the Gathering Table.
Any item collected in the Shadow Woods can be sold for **10 coins**.

mushroomJungle.warning: When you reach the top of a Colossus Mushroom, roll 1d6, discover what you find growing on its cap, and gather the items without needing any equipment.

prairieSea.hint: For collecting resources in the Prairie Sea, you can use Gardening Shears. To use them, remove 1 durability point from them, then choose the item of your choice from the gathering table above. Otherwise, successfully pass a Courage Test to do without the necessary equipment.

silentWastes.hint:
To collect resources in any hex of the Silent Wastes, you need to:
- Use a Pickaxe. Spend 1 durability point and choose an item from the Gathering Table.
- Or roll a Test of Courage and, on a Hit, roll what you find on the Gathering Table.
Any item collected in the Silent Wastes can be sold for **10 coins** in any town.

titanGarden.warning: Whenever you reach the top of a Garden Whale, roll 1d6 to find out what is there.

context_by_rank.2: **{name} is looking for something.** Maybe something not sold in this village, or something only found far from here? But beyond that, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} seems afraid of the unknown. Maybe there’s a story behind it.
context_by_rank.3: **{name} dreams of traveling to another village.** Maybe you could accompany them and learn more about their motivations and desires!
context_by_rank.4: **{name} is very ill and doesn’t have much time left.** {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} is {gender, select, man {alone} woman {alone} other {alone}} and no one to support them in these difficult moments. Maybe a conversation would bring some comfort? *Next time you visit this place, you’ll need to succeed a Courage test to find {gender, select, man {him} woman {her} other {them}}.*
context_by_rank.5: **{name} is seeking friendship—or maybe love?** You’re not sure, but {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} seems to feel {gender, select, man {lonely} woman {lonely} other {lonely}}. You can help them find someone who seeks something similar.
context_by_rank.6: **{name} longs for a loved one.** Maybe it’s someone who lives elsewhere or has just left. But {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} is also looking for a very special object that reminds them of this person. What is this object?
context_by_rank.7: {name} is a **cartographer**. You meet {gender, select, man {him} woman {her} other {them}} as {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} is about to leave the village and recognizes you as a traveler. {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} offers you one of their maps. Roll a D6: *Location Map (1-3)* or *Biome Map (4-6)* (see page 49).
context_by_rank.8: {name} is **painting a picture**. Realizing you’re a traveler, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} asks if you have a sketch of an unknown place, or if you can describe a panorama you’ve seen on your travels! {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} has never ventured far from their village and is seeking inspiration!
context_by_rank.9: There are rumors of mysterious Ruins scattered across the world, and **{name} is curious to learn more**. Seeing you’re a traveler, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} approaches you to see if you have any information to share!
context_by_rank.10: **{name} speaks a name while wandering the village.** Who is it? Why are they saying this name? What happened? *If you need to create a name, consult the table on page 60.*
context_by_rank.A: **{name} is mourning a recent loss.** {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} may have lost a pet or a close friend. Maybe a conversation would be welcome? Or perhaps {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} just needs someone to listen?
context_by_rank.J: **{name} buys objects from other parts of the world and offers 100 coins for each item of interest.** Talk to them! Maybe you have something {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} would like to acquire.
context_by_rank.Q: **{name} looks like someone you’ve met before.** Is it just an impression? You can always ask to be sure. {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} may have crossed your path before, or maybe it’s a stranger with new stories to tell!
context_by_rank.K: **{name} is a builder.** {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} tells you that with 3 wood and 3 iron, or 1,000 coins, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} can build the establishment of your choice in the village.

settings.auth_disclaimer: App settings are only saved locally in this browser and are not synced with your user account. If you use a different browser, the settings will not be shared.
settings.adaptive_appearance_theme_help: Overrides the app theme for the character sheet. Automatically switches to dark mode at night and light mode during the day based on the clock value.
settings.journal_timeline_reverse_chronological_h: By default, the journal is chronological; uncheck to display entries from newest to oldest.
settings.journal_create_entry_on_map_move_help: When you move to an adjacent map cell, a new journal entry is added with the next clock slice and a starter heading. Separate from automatically advancing the clock.
settings.journal_create_entry_on_map_move_label: Create a journal entry when moving on the map
settings.map_tick_clock_on_move_help: When you move to an adjacent cell, the clock position advances as if you had used the “Advance” button.
settings.map_show_biome_background_help: Show patterned backgrounds inside each cell based on its biome. Useful for distinguishing biomes without relying on color alone.
settings.map_coordinates_display_help: Choose where cell coordinates are shown: on the axes around the map, inside each cell, or both.
settings.map_style_help: Choose the visual style of the map: flat, always tilted in perspective, or tilting dynamically when hovering a row.
settings.language_warning: Please note that only the French language is canonical, as it is the language in which my game version is written. The English version is automatically translated without support from an English rulebook.
settings.sound_enabled_help: Plays ambient music matching the current biome. Enabling this will preload approximately 180 MB of audio files the first time.
settings.sound_variant_help: Choose between full soundtracks (music + ambiance), music-only, or ambiance-only. Changing this variant will reload the relevant files.
settings.title: Settings
settings.village_merge_duplicate_establishments_h: Merges duplicate village establishments into larger ones (small + small → large, etc.).
settings.shortcuts_enabled_help: Enables global keyboard shortcuts: {modifier}+S (save), {modifier}+D (card draw & dice roll), {modifier}+M (toggle music), {modifier}+C/V (copy/paste map cell).
settings.clear_cache_help: Removes all cached assets without impacting your saved data. Useful when the app is stuck on an outdated version.

village.title: Village Generator

J.red: **City.** It is a **large colony**. Draw **3 additional establishment cards**; if you draw a **face card** (Jack, Queen, King), **ignore it** and draw again until you get a **numbered card**.
J.black: **Wonder.** The village is **exceptionally beautiful**. Describe it. You gain **2 Inspiration Points**.

Q.red: **Fortified.** The village is **surrounded by walls** with a **guarded entrance**. You must have **at least 1 Honor Point** to enter.
Q.black: **Lush.** It features a **body of water** (river, lake, etc.) and a **garden**. You can use the **biome collection table** **without special equipment**.

K.red: **Abandoned.** The buildings seem **uninhabited**. The **establishments are inoperable** until someone decides to **rebuild the village**.
K.black: **Nomadic.** The village **moves**. When you return to this **map cell**, you must succeed a **Courage test**. On **failure**, the village **is no longer there**.

hero.eyebrow: A game companion for “The Protector’s Memories”
hero.title: ProMe
hero.tagline: Your journal, map, and toolkit for journeying through a forgotten world.

character.title: An up-to-date character sheet
character.body: Track everything that matters — health, stamina, resources, inventory, spells — on a persistent sheet that remembers your Protector between sessions. No spreadsheets, no paper.

map.title: An interactive map at every step
map.body: Draw your journey day by day, hex by hex. Annotate your map as your adventure unfolds, marking biomes and points of interest. The world opens up as you explore.

journal.title: A canonical journal
journal.body: Write your memories in rich Markdown. Embed dice rolls, card draws, and map references directly in your entries. Your story, written in your own words.

demo.title: Day 12 — Sunken Savannah
demo.content: The bridge was destroyed by the torrent.

dice.title: Built-in game tools
dice.body: Roll a six-sided die or draw from a playing card deck — all from inside the app. Results feed directly into your journal and character sheet.

music.title: Adaptive ambient sound
music.body: Soundtracks for every biome: from the Shadow Woods to the Sunken Savannah, immerse yourself in the game’s atmosphere without leaving the app — powered by [TableTopAudio](https://tabletopaudio.com/).

demo.track_2: Sunken Savannah — Spirit of the Plains

generators.title: Village and inhabitant generators
generators.body: Populate your world instantly — generate villages and their inhabitants without flipping through the rulebook. Save them to find them easily later.

final_cta.title: Ready to begin your journey?
final_cta.sub: Create your Protector and step into the world.

install_prompt.title: Install ProMe
install_prompt.description: Add ProMe to your home screen to play offline, enjoy a full-screen experience, and launch it in one tap.
install_prompt.description_ios: Tap the “Share” button then “Add to Home Screen” to play offline and launch ProMe from your home screen.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.sign_in_prompt:
You can sign in to ProMe with your Google account to back up your data online. This will allow you to retrieve your characters even if you change browsers or devices. It is completely optional, and the site works entirely without a connection. Clicking the button below will redirect you to Google to sign in, then you will be redirected to the home page.

For more information, please see the [FAQ](/en/faq#what-is-the-user-account-for-).
auth.sign_in_success: Sign in successful: syncing to cloud.
